content.value_statement: Regulated teams need consistent document control, change tracking, and submission-ready records. This skill guides DMS design, regulatory reviews, and quality documentation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Design document control frameworks for ISO 13485 quality systems.
Review regulatory documentation for structure, traceability, and submission readiness.
Plan change control workflows with impact assessment and approval steps.
Guide DMS requirements, configuration, validation, and deployment planning.
Define documentation KPIs for audits, training, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate documentation needs across quality, regulatory, training, and CAPA processes.
limitations: It does not replace qualified regulatory, legal, or quality system approval.
It does not validate records inside a live DMS automatically.
Several referenced scripts and detailed reference files are not included in this package.
Outputs need review against current regulations and company procedures.

use_cases.title: Build a Document Control Process
use_cases.description: Create a controlled document lifecycle with ownership, review, approval, retention, and obsolete document handling.

use_cases.title: Prepare Regulatory Documentation
use_cases.description: Check submission documents for completeness, structure, traceability, and alignment with target market expectations.

use_cases.title: Improve DMS Operations
use_cases.description: Define DMS requirements, workflow roles, validation needs, training controls, and performance measures.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Document Control Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a document control checklist for our medical device quality system. Include document creation, review, approval, distribution, retention, and obsolete document controls.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Procedure for Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this document control procedure for ISO 13485 alignment. Identify missing controls, weak wording, traceability gaps, and practical improvement actions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a DMS Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a DMS implementation plan for a regulated medical device company. Cover requirements, workflows, access control, validation, migration, training, and rollout risks.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Change Control Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our document change control program. Map each step from request to closure, evaluate risk controls, define metrics, and recommend governance improvements.

output_examples.input: A quality manager asks for a new document control process.
output: Document lifecycle stages from drafting through retirement.
Required roles for authors, reviewers, approvers, and document owners.
Controls for versioning, distribution, retention, and obsolete records.
Audit evidence to maintain for each controlled document.

output_examples.input: A regulatory team asks for a submission document readiness review.
output: Completeness checks for required sections and supporting records.
Traceability review across design, risk, clinical, and manufacturing documents.
Formatting and cross-reference issues that need correction.
Recommended approval path before submission release.

output_examples.input: A systems lead asks how to validate a new DMS workflow.
output: User requirements for routing, permissions, signatures, and audit trails.
Validation activities for configuration, access, records, and workflow testing.
Training and migration controls before production use.
Post-launch monitoring metrics for cycle time and compliance issues.

best_practices: Provide the target regulation, document type, lifecycle stage, and approval constraints.
Ask for traceability, ownership, and evidence expectations in every review.
Have qualified staff verify outputs before release or regulatory submission.
anti_patterns: Do not use outputs as final regulatory decisions without expert review.
Do not ask for generic templates without your document hierarchy and controls.
Do not skip validation evidence when changing electronic document workflows.

faq.question: What type of documentation does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports quality system, regulatory, technical, change control, training, and DMS documentation workflows.

faq.question: Can it approve documents for regulatory submission?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare review guidance, but authorized company reviewers must approve final documents.

faq.question: Does it support ISO 13485 document control?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill focuses on ISO 13485 document control, quality records, review workflows, and audit readiness.

faq.question: Can it help with 21 CFR Part 11 planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline electronic signature, audit trail, access control, validation, and record integrity considerations.

faq.question: Does it connect to my DMS?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning and review guidance, but it does not integrate with live systems by itself.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
